title: EU leaders scramble to avoid friction with the US under Trump and avoid a 'stupid tariff war'
description: BRUSSELS (AP) — After three years spent trying to deter Russia from destroying Ukraine, European Union leaders grappled on Monday with how to respond to a major ally who appears determined to start a trade war or even seize part of their territory.

title: Trump wants Ukraine to supply rare earth minerals to U.S. in exchange for future aid
description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday he wants Ukraine to supply the United States with rare earth minerals as a form of payment for financially supporting the country's war efforts against Russia.

title: Ukraine strikes Russian oil refinery for second time in 3 days
description: Ukrainian long-range drones struck one of Russia’s biggest oil refineries for the second time in three days, a senior Kyiv official said Monday, as Ukraine tries to slow the Russian army’s push along parts of the front line and the third anniversary of the war approaches.

title: Pro-Russia paramilitary leader Armen Sargsyan 'assassinated' in Moscow
description: Armen Sargsyan, a pro-Russia paramilitary leader from eastern Ukraine, was apparently assassinated in an explosion in Moscow on Monday morning.

title: Briton, 18, killed by Russian drone minutes into first mission in Ukraine - report
description: James Wilton, from Huddersfield, had no military experience before volunteering to fight against Russia

title: Global Flashpoints: Balkans Gun Violence, Gazan Dilemmas, and Trump's Trade War
description: A summary of world news highlights gun violence in the Balkans, Gazans' dilemmas post-ceasefire, Jenni Hermoso's trial testimony, Trump's trade tariffs, and global political tensions involving Russia, Ukraine, and the EU. Further noted are increased executions in the conflict and a notable Moscow bombing.

title: Europe's Strategic Awakening Amidst Global Tensions
description: French President Emmanuel Macron underscores the need for Europe to bolster its defensive autonomy amid tensions from Russia's actions in Ukraine and U.S. policy under Donald Trump. EU leaders discuss military capabilities and spending, highlighting growing emphasis on strategic independence and partnerships with NATO allies.

title: Kremlin's Cautious Approach to Zelenskiy's Peace Talks Proposal
description: The Kremlin dismisses Ukrainian President Zelenskiy's proposal for four-way peace talks involving the US, Ukraine, Russia, and the EU, citing concerns about Zelenskiy's electoral mandate. Moscow questions Zelenskiy's authority due to a decree banning talks with Russia while Putin remains in power.

title: India, Russia in 'active discussion' over RuPay & MIR mutual transactions
description: This will make RuPay one of the few international payment systems to be active in Russia. Moscow has faced a number of sanctions by Western countries since the war with Ukraine.

title: Moscow bomb kills pro-Russia paramilitary leader
description: Armen Sarkisyan, founder of battalion fighting against Ukraine, dies after blast that also killed bodyguard
